description:
❤️ Blood Donation Drive at CST Station ❤️

Today, our club had the privilege of participating in a Blood Donation Drive at CST Station, taking a meaningful step towards saving lives and spreading the spirit of humanity. ✨

A heartfelt thank you to Rtn. Devanshi Dave for attending the drive and generously donating blood. Your selfless contribution and kindness truly embody the spirit of service above self. ❤️🙏

We also sincerely appreciate our five dedicated Rotaract members who attended the drive, devoted their valuable time to volunteering, and supported this noble initiative. Your enthusiasm and commitment made a difference!
location: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus, Mumbai, Maharashtra
